normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach- 5 Adult bikes- Deeded beach access- 6-Passenger electric Low-Speed Vehicle- Private pool **Pool heating is available October through May for an additional fee of $35 per day, while cooling is offered from May through September at the same rate. Due to the electric heating system, the pool cannot be heated when outdoor temperatures drop below 55°F.- Two Washer/Dryers- Outdoor Cabana with TV- Close to Seaside- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Nestled in the renowned Seagrove Beach community, Sully’s by the Sea is an enchanting 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom home that sleeps 18 guests. Discover an inviting escape where the days are filled with adventure—biking, paddleboarding, kayaking, and more. Spend a breezy morning cruising the Timpoochee Trail, followed by a spontaneous jaunt to the beach to cool off in the sparkling surf. Guests will love relaxing on the covered back deck and the convenience of a private pool.Laidback luxury meets coastal charm in this 2-story home. As guests enter, sunlight paints cheerful swathes throughout the airy and open great room—accented with shiplap walls and bursts of cobalt and baby blue. Plan the day’s itinerary over a relaxed dinner at the beach-inspired table for 8, with 4 additional seats at the breakfast bar. Marble countertops and top-of-the-line appliances provide a well-equipped and beautiful backdrop for whipping up snacks, meals, or pitchers of sangria in the chef’s kitchen. Coffee lovers can brew a rich cup to sip on the back porch at the combined wet/coffee bar under the staircase. Let worries disappear on the salt-scented breeze in the idyllic backyard—secluded by neighboring privacy fences and lush natural greenery—where guests will find a built-in grill, patio, and pool. As night falls, retire to the guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom on this floor.The spacious second level hosts 3 guest bedrooms with king beds and private bathrooms. There’s also a bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds and 1 twin-over-twin that provides excellent lodgings for children, teens, and guests who don’t mind sharing space.With a private outdoor oasis and a central location, Sully’s by the Sea is the ultimate setting for a Seagrove Beach getaway. Day trips around the Emerald Coast are simple with parking for 5 vehicles, or enjoy days of exploring with the complimentary 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle and 5 adult bikes. Santa Clara Regional beach access is a 3-minute drive. Take Montigo Avenue and turn left on Elm Street, left at San Juan Avenue, and again at East County Highway 30A. Turn right at Bramble Grove Place. Continue to the parking lot. Book this Seagrove Beach home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 18):FIRST FLOOR: Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: 2 Full-over-Full Bunk Beds and 1 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboPlease note that there is active construction opposite this home.
